== Biography ==
Birth indexes name Mabel F C Glasgow and Lewis H Glasgow as parents of Madoline F (1892), Colin (1894) and Mary C (1896) at Casino, New South Wales.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/3248483 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Madoline F Glasgow, record 1778/3248483].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/3247840 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Colin Glasgow, record 1778/3247840].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/3248487 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Mary C Glasgow, record 1778/3248487].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Birth indexes name Mabel F C Glasgow and Lewis H Glasgow as parents of Madoline F (1892), Colin (1894) and Mary C (1896) at Casino, New South Wales. The shared names, district and chronology support one family; no marriage record is held, and Mabel’s maiden name, age, parents, death and later residence are unstated.
